name: SLX direct-mount front derailleur
weight_description: Manufacturer-listed average 150 g for FD-M661-D, 3×9-speed, down swing, direct-mount assembly, including its mounting bolt. The exact column identifies Direct Mount and the weight heading specifies direct type with bolt. Other mount variants do not inherit this weight. This is the nine-speed model, distinct from FD-M661-10.
